## WorkerThreadGatewayPath.normalize() method

Normalize a gateway socket path for the current platform.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static normalize(path: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

Platform-appropriate socket path.

## Exceptions

When the resolved POSIX path exceeds 104 characters.

## Remarks

On Windows, POSIX-style paths (`/tmp/server.sock`<!-- -->) and bare identifiers (`gateway-main`<!-- -->) are converted to named pipes (`\\.\pipe\...`<!-- -->). Dashes are escaped (`-` → `--`<!-- -->) before `/` is mapped to `-`<!-- -->, so `/tmp/a-b` and `/tmp/a/b` land on distinct pipes instead of colliding. Existing `\\.\pipe\` paths pass through unchanged.

On POSIX, absolute paths pass through unchanged (after a length check); relative or bare identifiers are resolved against `os.tmpdir()` so socket files never pollute the process working directory.

## Example


```typescript
// On Windows: "\\\\.\\pipe\\gateway--main"
WorkerThreadGatewayPath.normalize("gateway-main");
```
